rules.description: Required generator schema columns are present
Required values are non-null and non-blank
Age is numeric and between 0 and 120 years
Sex is one of M, F, or U
Onset date parses as a valid date
Report date parses as a valid date
Onset date is not after report date
Report delay is between 0 and 21 days
ICD-10 code belongs to the encounter generator's code set
Outcome is recovered, referred, or died
Encounter ID is unique within the load
Facility ID exists in the local registry when available
District agrees with facility mapping and local geography
Dates and numeric values are within reasonable bounds

forecast_evaluation.method: Spark grouped ridge model with four lagged weekly case/weather observations

assumptions.forecast_method: Spark ridge model using four lagged weekly case and weather observations; empirical training-residual intervals. See forecast_evaluation for measured backtest results.
assumptions.alert_rule: EARS C1 scores daily cases against the preceding 28 calendar days; dashboard candidates must meet the selected score threshold and show at least 50% growth in the recent 28-day daily mean. Counts below 5 are suppressed.
assumptions.stock_source: Synthetic planning scenario generated from facility capacity; replace with the course S6 stock feed before treating this as a real stock position.
assumptions.stock_assumptions: Synthetic facility stock quantities are seeded per facility from registered bed capacity; they are for dashboard and optimizer testing only.
assumptions.demand_conversion: Beds = admissions × average stay ÷ 28 days; IV saline = admissions × 2; NS1 kits = dengue forecast cases; ORS = diarrhoea forecast × 1.2; antimalarials = malaria forecast × 0.9.
assumptions.allocation_method: PuLP/CBC minimizes severity-weighted unmet demand across resource pools subject to current national stock and budget. The equity floor requires each district to receive at least alpha × its population share of allocations for each resource.
